annotation.summary_en: This is a Chinese national standards catalogue page for GB/T 45312-2025, a voluntary standard on operational design conditions for automated driving systems in intelligent connected vehicles. It was issued on 28 February 2025 under TC114/SC34. The page shows only metadata and lists related automated-driving standards.
key_provisions_or_claims: Recommended national standard GB/T 45312-2025 sets out operational design conditions for automated driving systems
Issued 2025-02-28; plan number 20230388-T-339; technical committee TC114/SC34 (road vehicles)
Classified under ICS 43.020 (road vehicles in general)
Related standards include GB 44497-2024 on data recording systems and GB 44721 on automated driving system safety requirements
